hero.title:
Optimize Crews, Equipment,

 BuilderTek Resource Management
hero.description:
Plan smarter, reduce downtime, and keep every project properly staffed without the guesswork.

Give construction teams real-time visibility into labor, crews, and equipment across all projects and allocate resources efficiently, avoiding conflicts. Ensure the right people and assets are in the right place at the right time with the Salesforce-native platform.

financialControl.title: Seamless Construction Resource Planning Across Teams
financialControl.description: One system to manage labor, crews, and availability across projects, built for real-world construction complexities.
features: BuilderTek Resource Management tool replaces reactive scheduling and disconnected tracking with a centralized, real-time view of workforce and equipment utilization. Designed specifically for construction workflows, it connects schedules, tasks, and project timelines, so resource decisions are based on accurate data, not assumptions.

items.question: Can BuilderTek manage both labor and equipment resources?
items.answer: Yes. BuilderTek supports tracking and planning for both workforce and equipment resources for on-site and off-site resources.

items.question: Does Resource Management integrate with project schedules?
items.answer: Absolutely. The BuildeTek resource management tool can be directly aligned with project schedules and milestones.
